name: partial-migration-leftover
description: Agent fixes an async/await migration bug where fetchAndFormat doesn't await an async formatter (obvious, tests fail with '[object Promise]'). But formatter.js also has a date formatting bug: getMonth() is 0-indexed but not corrected, so January displays as month '00'. This is visible in the formatted output but tests don't check the date portion. Agent must notice the off-by-one month.
